newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean firms buy 59,500 tonnes of Chinese corn.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean firms buy 59,500 tonnes of Chinese corn.

text.p: South Korean feed milling companies bought 25,500 tonnes of Chinese corn at $141.60 a tonne C&F from Haitai International Inc and 34,000 tonnes at $139.90 a tonne C&F from Daewoo Corp, traders said on Monday.
The buyers included Cheil Jedang Corp, Miwon Co Ltd, Woo Sung Feed Mill Co Ltd, Taihan Sugar Corp and Purina Korea Inc.
The purchases were made through private negotiations.
Traders said arrival for 25,500 tonnes was slated for May 20 and 30 to the port of Kunsan, while 34,000 tonnes were set for May 20 to the port of Inchon.
In February, South Korean buyers bought a total of 111,500 tonnes of Chinese corn from Toepfer through private negotiations.
